fullContentHtml:
HPSC PGT Computer Science Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the result for the post of Graduate Teacher PGT (Computer Science). This recruitment has been issued for 1672 posts. Online applying process for HPSC PGT Computer Science Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 16 February 2026 to 09 March 2026. The examination was held on 17 May 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for HPSC PGT Computer Science Result 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 05 February 2026
  • Application Start Date : 16 February 2026
  • Last Date : 09 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 09 March 2026
  • New Exam Date : 17 May 2026
  • Admit Card : 11 May 2026
  • Result : 06 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, BC-A, BC-B, EWS, ESM : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

HPSC PGT Computer Science Result 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 09 March 2026.

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
